Apply for Software Engineer

This role is ideal for a Software Engineer who enjoys hands-on development, learning from experienced teammates, and working across multiple clients and projects in a fast-paced consulting environment.

About Added Innovation

Added Innovation is a values-driven technology consulting firm that partners with large, mission-focused non-profit associations to solve complex technical challenges and support systems that matter. We believe success is built through genuine partnerships, not one-off projects, and we work collaboratively with our clients to make their missions possible with integrity, transparency, and hard work. Our team brings deep expertise in NetForum Enterprise, Microsoft Azure, digital transformation strategies, and we thrive on curiosity, adaptability, and real-world problem-solving in every engagement.

Description
What You’ll Do
Implement software solutions designed by senior engineers and architects
Develop and maintain applications using C#, ASP.NET (Web Forms and/or MVC), and SQL Server
Work within existing codebases, including legacy systems
Troubleshoot issues across development, test, and production environments
Collaborate with teammates to deliver high-quality solutions for multiple clients
Communicate directly with clients as needed to clarify requirements or resolve issues
Continuously improve your technical skills and understanding of the platforms we support

 

What You’ll Need
0–5 years of professional software development experience (or equivalent education and project work)
Microsoft .NET training or hands-on experience
Experience with:
C#
ASP.NET
SQL and relational databases
Visual Studio
Source control (Git, TFVC, or similar)
Ability to implement defined solutions independently
Comfort working across multiple projects and clients in a single day
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Clear communication skills
A humble, curious, and coachable mindset
Willingness to learn and recognize personal strengths and limitations

 

What Would Be Nice
NetForum AMS experience
Experience with ASP.NET Web Forms or MVC
JavaScript and jQuery experience
Exposure to SOAP APIs or legacy integrations
Association or nonprofit industry experience
Consulting or client-facing experience
Azure DevOps experience
Exposure to Microsoft Azure infrastructure
Microsoft, SQL Server, or Azure certifications

 

Job Type

Full-time

 

Salary Range

$80,000 - $100,000

 

Work Location

Springfield, MO | Tulsa, OK | Remote (USA)

 

We value in-person collaboration and prefer candidates located in or near Springfield, MO or Tulsa, OK. That said, we are open to fully remote candidates anywhere in the United States.

Salary

$80,000 - $100,000 per year
